title: Lattice wave
description: A forest-green line lattice flexes over a violet field as its tension changes.
useCase: A controllable woven or technical line texture.
interaction: Adjust tension and pause the field.
reducedMotion: The mesh stays still; tension renders an immediate new static mesh.
limitations: Canvas 2D line deformation, not a cloth solver.
look: Dark green line grid with small square nodes on a vivid violet field, a bold sans label above, a thin slider and monospace readout below.
motion: Grid nodes sway continuously in two slow crossing sine waves, damped so the outer frame stays straight; a tension slider scales the amplitude and a button pauses it.
adapt: Everything is drawn in `draw`: `point` displaces each node with sines of `clock`, `amp` scales with `tension`, and `cols`/`rows` set density. Tune the 1700 divisor in `tick` for speed and recolour via `strokeStyle` and the section background.
